reviewVerdicts.rationale: Question 1 is no. The review skill requires each round's complete file contents to be returned (workspace/.agents/skills/review/SKILL.md:48-55). The claimed final dry round (backend-review.log:39768, summarized at :40246) used `Get-Content ... -Raw | Out-Null` for the scoped configuration, source, and test files (backend-review.log:39561-39679), so those contents were not returned or examined in that round. The required gate was also not clean: `pnpm check:watch rebuild` failed with TS5042 (backend-review.log:31084), and the later `pnpm check:watch` ended by timeout 124 (backend-review.log:35572); the final report acknowledges this at :40246. Question 2 is no. The workspace testing contract requires one test per operation with working-path/refusal coverage and business assertions (workspace/.agents/skills/backend/testing.md:26-41, :132, :151-160). `packages/backend/test/features/api/shopping/test_api_shopping_operation_boundaries.ts:15-124` puts roughly a hundred accessors into one test and checks only a generic thrown-error refusal via lines 5-11; it supplies no operation-specific working paths or business effects. It also uses `any` and an `as (...args: any[])` cast at lines 5 and 124, expressly forbidden by testing.md:166-176. Unverified: unrelated implementation defects were not assessed because they are outside the two questions.

The contract scaffold's render-only assertion is explicitly allowed by the contract-mode rules (workspace/.agents/skills/frontend/verification.md:54-59); no other unverified premise is needed.
